downtimeInfo.title: Nautilus 3i Behavior Issues
downtimeInfo.message: Nautilus 3i is having some problems generating quality outputs after its latest update. I have identified the issues and are waiting on the model to finish training (then run benchmarks) to ensure all problems are solved. For now, please be extra careful of misinformation of specific details in its replies. I will keep you updated, as this will take a few days due to other commitments.

infoBoard.title: Welcome to Nautilus Client!
infoBoard.message: The Closed Alpha test has started for remote users! Feel free to report any issues or bugs during this first round of testing.
